title: Length of a Degree of Latitude

blocks.content: The distance between two latitudes is approximately 111 kilometers anywhere on Earth because latitudes are parallel circles.
The distance between two latitudes is approximately 111 kilometers anywhere on Earth because latitudes are parallel circles.

items: 1 degree of latitude equals approximately 111 km everywhere on Earth.
Latitudes are parallel circles, unlike longitudes which converge at the poles.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The distance between two adjacent degrees of latitude is roughly 111 kilometers across the globe.
Lines of latitude form parallel circles around the Earth, preventing them from converging.
